basis: Manual reading of the saved titles and 1200-character abstracts before the v2 live replay; not a full-text or independent expert gold standard.
policy: Actual diamond-material research, including diamond-property computations and NV sensing proposals; exclude generic DAC use and homonyms.

caveats.12: WBG probe-card review mentions diamond among many materials, but the truncated abstract cannot establish a diamond-specific contribution; excluded from accuracy calculation.
caveats.26: Relevant NV-diamond coherence proposal, not evidence of consciousness-dependent decoherence. Summary must explicitly label the proposal and absence of demonstrated results.
caveats.1,4,7,9,18,19,37: Clear material relevance from title; abstract absent or only bibliographic boilerplate. Do not invent methods or results.
caveats.27,28: Same chair description with distinct Zenodo DOIs. Exclude both, but do not silently assert they are the same deposit.
